## The Lorenz System

The curve below traces a solution to the **Lorenz system**:

$$
\frac{dx}{dt} = \sigma(y - x), \qquad
\frac{dy}{dt} = x(\rho - z) - y, \qquad
\frac{dz}{dt} = xy - \beta z
$$

Set the parameters and initial condition, then press **start** to trace the solution.
Drag to rotate; scroll to zoom. Press **stop** at any time to explore the curve, then **start** again to continue. **Reset** clears the curve and unlocks the sliders.

```{=html}
<style>
#lz{font-family:var(--bs-font-monospace,monospace);margin:1.5rem 0 2rem}
#lz-canvas{display:block;width:100%;height:460px;border-radius:6px;background:#0d1117;cursor:grab}
#lz-canvas:active{cursor:grabbing}
.lz-section-label{font-size:11px;color:#6a8090;letter-spacing:.08em;text-transform:uppercase;margin-top:14px;margin-bottom:5px}
.lz-row{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:10px 20px;align-items:flex-end}
.lz-p{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:3px;flex:1;min-width:110px}
.lz-p label{font-size:12px;color:#6a8090;letter-spacing:.05em}
.lz-pr{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px}
.lz-pr input[type=range]{flex:1;accent-color:#6ec6f5;cursor:pointer}
.lz-pr input[type=range]:disabled{opacity:.35;cursor:default}
.lz-v{font-size:12px;color:#aaccdd;min-width:34px;text-align:right}
.lz-btns{display:flex;gap:6px;align-items:flex-end;padding-bottom:1px}
.lz-btn{background:transparent;border:1px solid #2a3a4a;color:#7a9aaa;font-size:12px;
  font-family:var(--bs-font-monospace,monospace);padding:5px 14px;border-radius:4px;
  cursor:pointer;transition:all .15s}
.lz-btn:hover:not(:disabled){border-color:#6ec6f5;color:#cce8ff}
.lz-btn:disabled{opacity:.3;cursor:default}
.lz-btn.resuming{border-color:#6ef5b0;color:#6ef5b0}
.lz-legend{display:flex;gap:16px;margin-top:10px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.lz-li{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:5px;font-size:12px;color:#6a8090}
.lz-swatch{width:9px;height:9px;border-radius:50%;flex-shrink:0}
.lz-hint{font-size:11px;color:#3a5060;margin-top:6px}
</style>

<div id="lz">
  <canvas id="lz-canvas"></canvas>

  <div class="lz-section-label">Select Parameters:</div>
  <div class="lz-row">
    <div class="lz-p"><label>σ (sigma)</label><div class="lz-pr"><input type="range" id="lz-sigma" min="1" max="30" step=".5" value="10"><span class="lz-v" id="lz-sv">10.0</span></div></div>
    <div class="lz-p"><label>ρ (rho)</label><div class="lz-pr"><input type="range" id="lz-rho" min=".5" max="60" step=".5" value="28"><span class="lz-v" id="lz-rv">28.0</span></div></div>
    <div class="lz-p"><label>β (beta)</label><div class="lz-pr"><input type="range" id="lz-beta" min=".5" max="6" step=".1" value="2.7"><span class="lz-v" id="lz-bv">2.7</span></div></div>
  </div>

  <div class="lz-section-label" style="margin-top:10px">Select Initial Condition:</div>
  <div class="lz-row">
    <div class="lz-p"><label>x₀</label><div class="lz-pr"><input type="range" id="lz-x0" min="-20" max="20" step=".5" value="1"><span class="lz-v" id="lz-x0v">1.0</span></div></div>
    <div class="lz-p"><label>y₀</label><div class="lz-pr"><input type="range" id="lz-y0" min="-20" max="20" step=".5" value="1"><span class="lz-v" id="lz-y0v">1.0</span></div></div>
    <div class="lz-p"><label>z₀</label><div class="lz-pr"><input type="range" id="lz-z0" min="0" max="50" step=".5" value="10"><span class="lz-v" id="lz-z0v">10.0</span></div></div>
    <div class="lz-btns">
      <button class="lz-btn" id="lz-start">start</button>
      <button class="lz-btn" id="lz-stop" disabled>stop</button>
      <button class="lz-btn" id="lz-reset">reset</button>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="lz-legend">
    <div class="lz-li"><div class="lz-swatch" style="background:#6ec6f5"></div>solution curve</div>
    <div class="lz-li"><div class="lz-swatch" style="background:#f5e96e"></div>initial condition</div>
    <div class="lz-li"><div class="lz-swatch" style="background:#6ef5a0"></div>current position</div>
    <div class="lz-li"><div class="lz-swatch" style="background:#e8a0f5"></div>fixed points</div>
  </div>
  <p class="lz-hint">drag to rotate · scroll to zoom · sliders lock while animating</p>
</div>

<script>
(function(){

const cv  = document.getElementById('lz-canvas');
const ctx = cv.getContext('2d');
const dpr = window.devicePixelRatio || 1;

function resize(){
  const r = cv.getBoundingClientRect();
  cv.width  = r.width  * dpr;
  cv.height = r.height * dpr;
  ctx.setTransform(dpr,0,0,dpr,0,0);
}
resize();
window.addEventListener('resize', resize);

let sigma=10, rho=28, beta=2.7;
let x0=1, y0=1, z0=10;
let rotX=0.45, rotZ=0.3, zoom=3.4;
let drag=false, lmx=0, lmy=0;
let pts=[], state='idle';

function cw(){ return cv.getBoundingClientRect(); }

function proj(p){
  const {width:w,height:h} = cw();
  const cx=Math.cos(rotX), sx=Math.sin(rotX);
  const cz=Math.cos(rotZ), sz=Math.sin(rotZ);
  const px=p.x, py=p.y, pz=p.z-25;
  const y1=py*cx-pz*sx, z1=py*sx+pz*cx;
  const x2=px*cz-y1*sz;
  return { sx: w/2+x2*zoom, sy: h/2-z1*zoom };
}

function deriv(x,y,z){
  return { x:sigma*(y-x), y:x*(rho-z)-y, z:x*y-beta*z };
}
function rk4(x,y,z,dt){
  const k1=deriv(x,y,z);
  const k2=deriv(x+k1.x*dt/2, y+k1.y*dt/2, z+k1.z*dt/2);
  const k3=deriv(x+k2.x*dt/2, y+k2.y*dt/2, z+k2.z*dt/2);
  const k4=deriv(x+k3.x*dt,   y+k3.y*dt,   z+k3.z*dt);
  return {
    x: x+(k1.x+2*k2.x+2*k3.x+k4.x)*dt/6,
    y: y+(k1.y+2*k2.y+2*k3.y+k4.y)*dt/6,
    z: z+(k1.z+2*k2.z+2*k3.z+k4.z)*dt/6
  };
}

function fixedPts(){
  const fp=[{x:0,y:0,z:0}];
  if(rho>1){
    const r=Math.sqrt(beta*(rho-1));
    fp.push({x:r,y:r,z:rho-1},{x:-r,y:-r,z:rho-1});
  }
  return fp;
}

function drawAxes(){
  const NEG=25, POS=25;
  const axes=[
    {from:{x:-NEG,y:0,z:0},      to:{x:POS,y:0,z:0},      lbl:'x'},
    {from:{x:0,y:-NEG,z:0},      to:{x:0,y:POS,z:0},      lbl:'y'},
    {from:{x:0,y:0,z:25-NEG},    to:{x:0,y:0,z:25+POS},   lbl:'z'}
  ];
  ctx.lineWidth=1;
  ctx.font='bold 12px monospace';
  for(const ax of axes){
    const fp=proj(ax.from), tp=proj(ax.to);
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(fp.sx,fp.sy);
    ctx.lineTo(tp.sx,tp.sy);
    ctx.strokeStyle='#2e4a5a';
    ctx.stroke();
    const dx=tp.sx-fp.sx, dy=tp.sy-fp.sy;
    const d=Math.sqrt(dx*dx+dy*dy)||1;
    ctx.fillStyle='#4a8090';
    ctx.fillText(ax.lbl, tp.sx+dx/d*10-4, tp.sy+dy/d*10+4);
  }
}

function drawScene(){
  const {width:w,height:h} = cw();
  ctx.clearRect(0,0,w,h);
  ctx.fillStyle='#0d1117';
  ctx.fillRect(0,0,w,h);

  drawAxes();

  for(const fp of fixedPts()){
    const p=proj(fp);
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(p.sx,p.sy,5,0,Math.PI*2);
    ctx.fillStyle='#e8a0f5'; ctx.strokeStyle='#0d1117'; ctx.lineWidth=1;
    ctx.fill(); ctx.stroke();
  }

  if(pts.length>=2){
    ctx.beginPath();
    const p0=proj(pts[0]);
    ctx.moveTo(p0.sx,p0.sy);
    for(let i=1;i<pts.length;i++){const p=proj(pts[i]);ctx.lineTo(p.sx,p.sy);}
    ctx.strokeStyle='#6ec6f5'; ctx.lineWidth=1.2; ctx.globalAlpha=.88;
    ctx.stroke(); ctx.globalAlpha=1;

    const head=proj(pts[pts.length-1]);
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(head.sx,head.sy,4,0,Math.PI*2);
    ctx.fillStyle='#6ef5a0'; ctx.strokeStyle='#0d1117'; ctx.lineWidth=1;
    ctx.fill(); ctx.stroke();
  }

  const icPt = state==='idle' ? {x:x0,y:y0,z:z0} : (pts.length>=1 ? pts[0] : null);
  if(icPt){
    const ic=proj(icPt);
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(ic.sx,ic.sy,6,0,Math.PI*2);
    ctx.fillStyle='#f5e96e'; ctx.strokeStyle='#0d1117'; ctx.lineWidth=1.5;
    ctx.fill(); ctx.stroke();
  }
}

const DT=0.005, SPF=5;
function stepSim(){
  if(!pts.length) return;
  let {x,y,z}=pts[pts.length-1];
  for(let s=0;s<SPF;s++){const n=rk4(x,y,z,DT);pts.push(n);x=n.x;y=n.y;z=n.z;}
}

function loop(){
  if(state==='running') stepSim();
  drawScene();
  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
}
loop();

function allSliders(off){
  ['lz-sigma','lz-rho','lz-beta','lz-x0','lz-y0','lz-z0']
    .forEach(id=>{ document.getElementById(id).disabled=off; });
}
function syncButtons(){
  const bs=document.getElementById('lz-start'), bp=document.getElementById('lz-stop');
  if(state==='idle'){
    bs.textContent='start'; bs.disabled=false; bs.classList.remove('resuming');
    bp.disabled=true; allSliders(false);
  } else if(state==='running'){
    bs.disabled=true; bs.classList.remove('resuming');
    bp.disabled=false; allSliders(true);
  } else {
    bs.textContent='resume'; bs.disabled=false; bs.classList.add('resuming');
    bp.disabled=true; allSliders(true);
  }
}

document.getElementById('lz-start').addEventListener('click',()=>{
  if(state==='idle') pts=[{x:x0,y:y0,z:z0}];
  state='running'; syncButtons();
});
document.getElementById('lz-stop').addEventListener('click',()=>{ state='paused'; syncButtons(); });
document.getElementById('lz-reset').addEventListener('click',()=>{ state='idle'; pts=[]; syncButtons(); });

function bindSlider(id,outId,dec,setter){
  document.getElementById(id).addEventListener('input',function(){
    const v=parseFloat(this.value);
    document.getElementById(outId).textContent=v.toFixed(dec);
    setter(v);
  });
}
bindSlider('lz-sigma','lz-sv',1,v=>sigma=v);
bindSlider('lz-rho',  'lz-rv',1,v=>rho=v);
bindSlider('lz-beta', 'lz-bv',1,v=>beta=v);
bindSlider('lz-x0',  'lz-x0v',1,v=>x0=v);
bindSlider('lz-y0',  'lz-y0v',1,v=>y0=v);
bindSlider('lz-z0',  'lz-z0v',1,v=>z0=v);

cv.addEventListener('mousedown',e=>{drag=true;lmx=e.clientX;lmy=e.clientY;});
window.addEventListener('mouseup',()=>drag=false);
window.addEventListener('mousemove',e=>{
  if(!drag) return;
  rotZ+=(e.clientX-lmx)*.008; rotX+=(e.clientY-lmy)*.008;
  lmx=e.clientX; lmy=e.clientY;
});
cv.addEventListener('touchstart',e=>{
  drag=true; lmx=e.touches[0].clientX; lmy=e.touches[0].clientY;
},{passive:true});
window.addEventListener('touchend',()=>drag=false);
window.addEventListener('touchmove',e=>{
  if(!drag) return;
  rotZ+=(e.touches[0].clientX-lmx)*.008; rotX+=(e.touches[0].clientY-lmy)*.008;
  lmx=e.touches[0].clientX; lmy=e.touches[0].clientY;
},{passive:true});
cv.addEventListener('wheel',e=>{
  zoom=Math.max(1,Math.min(14,zoom*(e.deltaY>0?.93:1.07)));
  e.preventDefault();
},{passive:false});

syncButtons();
})();
</script>
```

*Classic parameters: σ = 10, ρ = 28, β = 8/3 ≈ 2.7. Try reducing ρ below 24.74 — the chaos disappears and solutions settle onto one of the fixed points.*
